An experimental regulator assembled by the scientists at Yantar after a salvaged detector recorded the same anomalous discharge twice, a fraction of a second apart. A caged Sparkler fragment and a modified detection coil briefly couple the operator to that resonance. Whether the world slows down or the mind races ahead remains disputed. The fatigue is not. The field notes leaked out of the bunker; a few technicians now know how to rebuild the circuit. Assign to a medical/food quick slot: use once to activate and again to deactivate. Reusable; drains stamina while active. Only Professor Sakharov sells this device. It cannot be crafted. MCM can also grant it for testing. Excessive use causes temporary resonance sickness. Configure it in MCM.

Load a game, obtain the regulator here or buy it from Professor Sakharov, and assign it to a medical/food quick slot. Use once to activate and again to deactivate. Keep Echo installed while your save contains the regulator.
Requested: close MCM and check backpack

Echo overload: repeated activation or prolonged use causes the vanilla drunken camera and screen effects. Defaults: 4 activations within 30 seconds OR 8 seconds continuously; recovery 20 seconds after the last trigger. Times count gameplay seconds. Each trigger refreshes recovery; prolonged use keeps symptoms active. Camera and screen can be disabled separately.
